name: Tile Flip
description: A grid of coloured tiles with the time written in lit tiles. Tiles flip with a bouncy overshoot: a wave on every wake-up or tap, the tiles of a changing minute, and a few random ones every few seconds. All drawn by the watch on one canvas, no pictures.

steps.script:
let e = await addElement('CANVAS', { x: 0, y: 0, w: 390, h: 450, show: 'normal', handle: 'k1' }); Object.assign(e, { x: 0, y: 0, name: 'Tile canvas' })
    project.groups = project.groups || {}; project.groups.gCanvas = 'Canvas'; project.elements.find((x) => x.name === 'Tile canvas').group = 'gCanvas'; return 1
